$comment: LOINC mapping for the 34 clinical variables loaded into FHIR R4. `verified` means the LOINC code was checked against loinc.org by the human at the time of writing; `unverified` codes must be re-checked before any patient-facing use. Units are UCUM. See README.md in this directory for how each code was chosen.

O2Sat.display: Oxygen saturation [Percent] by Pulse oximetry in Arterial blood
O2Sat.note: Pulse oximetry (SpO2), the bedside sensor; distinct from SaO2 which is an ABG measurement.

SBP.note: Invasive or cuff, challenge does not distinguish.

EtCO2.display: Carbon dioxide [Partial pressure] in Exhaled gas -- end tidal
EtCO2.note: End-tidal CO2 code chosen from memory; verify against loinc.org.

BaseExcess.note: Verify code and matrix (arterial vs venous).

FiO2.note: Challenge stores the fraction (0.21..1.0); UCUM unitless, so value is the stored fraction.

pH.note: Venous pH code; arterial pH is 11558-4. The challenge does not state the blood source; verify before use.

PaCO2.display: Carbon dioxide [Partial pressure] in Arterial blood

SaO2.note: ABG-derived saturation; distinct from pulse-oximetry O2Sat.

AST.display: Aspartate aminotransferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

BUN.display: Urea nitrogen [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

Alkalinephos.display: Alkaline phosphatase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

TroponinI.display: Troponin I.cardiac [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
TroponinI.note: cTnI is assay-dependent; the challenge value's unit (ng/mL) assumed from literature. Verify.

Hct.note: Stored as percent in the source data.

WBC.note: UCUM unit string for thousands per uL is written '10*3/uL'; display unit '10^3/uL'.

SepsisLabel.display: Sepsis onset: study label (local marker, not a LOINC/SNOMED code)
SepsisLabel.note: Not a standard code. The Challenge SepsisLabel is a research annotation (1 from t_sepsis-6h to end of stay); loaded so the dashboard can mark the true onset hour. See docs/data_notes.md.
